title: When Your Business Needs a Custom Web Application in Kenya
title_sw: Wakati Biashara Yako Inahitaji Programu Maalum ya Wavuti Kenya
excerpt: Signs a normal website is no longer enough, what a custom web app actually solves, and how to scope it from KSh 150,000.

content:
## Website or web application?

A website answers questions. A web application does work.

That distinction sounds small, but it saves a lot of money. If your site only needs to explain services, show contact details and publish articles, it is a website. If people need to log in, submit records, see status, approve requests, or share the same data, you are describing a web application.

The Custom package starts from KSh 150,000 because the work begins with understanding a process, not arranging pages.

## Signs you have outgrown a website

Your team is using spreadsheets that get emailed back and forth. Customers ask for updates that you have to look up manually. The same information is typed in three places. A task depends on one person remembering to send a message.

None of these problems are solved by a prettier homepage. They are solved by a system with clear rules: who can see what, who can change what, and what happens next.

If two or more people repeat the same digital task every week, write it down. That written process is the beginning of a specification.

## What to write in your brief

Do not start with a list of screens. Start with the problem.

Write the current process in plain language. Name the people involved. List what they receive, what they decide, and what they produce. Mark the steps that are slow, error-prone, or depend on memory. Then describe what the result should look like when the process works well.

Good briefs are boring. They are specific about names, timing, and exceptions. Exceptions are where projects usually fail.

## How the work is scoped

Custom work starts with discovery and a written specification. The specification agrees on the problem, the users, the data, and the boundaries before code is written. That protects your budget and gives both sides something concrete to approve.

After that, the build is delivered in reviewable stages. You should be able to see working software before the whole project is finished. Payment remains per issue, with no automatic debit.

## What a custom app should not be

It should not be a copy of a foreign product with your logo added. It should not be built for every possible future user. It should solve your actual process well enough that people stop using the spreadsheet.

Start with the smallest useful version. Improve it with real feedback.

## Next step

Use the Start a project button, or send a WhatsApp message to 0705 023 432 describing one repeated task in your business. That single task is often enough to start a serious conversation about a custom web application.
content_sw:
## Tovuti au programu ya wavuti?

Tovuti hujibu maswali. Programu ya wavuti hufanya kazi.

Tofauti hiyo inaonekana ndogo, lakini huokoa pesa nyingi. Ikiwa tovuti yako inahitaji tu kueleza huduma, kuonyesha mawasiliano, na kuchapisha makala, ni tovuti. Ikiwa watu wanahitaji kuingia, kutuma taarifa, kuona hali, kuidhinisha maombi, au kushiriki data ile ile, unaelezea programu ya wavuti.

Kifurushi cha Custom kinaanza KSh 150,000 kwa sababu kazi huanza na kuelewa mchakato, si kupanga kurasa.

## Ishara kwamba umekua zaidi ya tovuti

Timu yako inatumia spreadsheets zinazotumwa mara kwa mara. Wateja wanauliza masasisho ambayo unapaswa kutafuta kwa mkono. Taarifa ile ile inaandikwa mahali patatu. Kazi moja inategemea mtu kukumbuka kutuma ujumbe.

Hakuna hata moja ya matatizo haya litatatuliwa na ukurasa mzuri wa nyumbani. Yanatatuliwa na mfumo wenye sheria wazi: nani anaona nini, nani anabadilisha nini, na nini kinatokea ifuatayo.

Ikiwa watu wawili au zaidi wana kazi ile ile ya kidijitali kila wiki, yiandike. Mchakato huo ulioandikwa ni mwanzo wa vipimo.

## Cha kuandika kwenye muhtasari wako

Usianze na orodha ya skrini. Anza na tatizo.

Andika mchakato wa sasa kwa lugha rahisi. Taja watu wanaohusika. Orodhesha wanachopokea, wanachoamua, na wanachotoa. Weka alama kwenye hatua zinazochelewesha, zinazokosea, au zinazotegemea kumbukumbu. Kisha elezea matokeo yatakavyokuwa mchakato ukifanya kazi vizuri.

Muhtasari mzuri ni wa kuchosha. Ni mahususi kwa majina, muda, na hali za kipekee. Hali za kipekee ndipo miradi huvunjika.

## Jinsi kazi inavyopangwa

Kazi maalum huanza na ugunduzi na vipimo vilivyoandikwa. Vipimo vinakubali tatizo, watumiaji, data, na mipaka kabla kodi kuandikwa. Hiyo inalinda bajeti yako na kuwapa pande zote kitu halali cha kukubali.

Baadaye, kazi hutolewa kwa hatua zinazoweza kukaguliwa. Unapaswa kuona programu inayofanya kazi kabla mradi wote kumalizika. Malipo bado ni kwa kila kazi, bila malipo ya moja kwa moja.

## Programu maalum isipaswa kuwa nini

Isipaswa kuwa nakala ya bidhaa ya nchi nyingine yenye nembo yako. Isipaswa kujengwa kwa kila mtumiaji wa baadaye anayewezekana. Inapaswa kutatua mchakato wako halisi vizuri kiasi kwamba watu wanaacha kutumia spreadsheet.

Anza na toleo dogo linalofaa. Liboreshe kwa maoni halisi.

## Hatua inayofuata

Tumia kitufe cha Start a project, au tuma WhatsApp kwa 0705 023 432 ukielezea kazi moja inayorudiwa kwenye biashara yako. Kazi hiyo moja mara nyingi inatosha kuanza mazungumzo makini ya programu maalum ya wavuti.
